title: infinite ore!
description: If you use this mod, you can become to infinite what ore.
body:
*I can't speak English very well. So I usually use google translate or use wrong English grammer.

This mod support for English and Japanese.



<your attention please>

> You may be going to feel this mod is cheating.
> You need to spend rare items for added items in this mod.

<explaination>

> If you use this mod, you can get infinite ore.

<how to use>

> If you want to get infinite coal, put "Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template" in center, and put coal blocks around it.
> If you want to get infinite iron, put "Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template" in center, and put iron blocks around it.
> For other ores, do the same by placing ”Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template" in center and put the ore blocks around it.


> While you have one of the items added in this mod, if you break stones or deepslate by diamond pickaxe or netherite pickaxe, you can get the ore which you used the Template.
